name: Invoices
description: Stand-in assistants, so nothing to set up: one reads an invoice, a big one waits for your yes, a reminder goes in the calendar, and the vendor goes into your money notes. The quickest way to see a flow run.
example: Invoice INV-2041 from Northwind Traders: ₹45,000 for October design work, due 30 October 2026.

replies.*: Added a reminder on 2026-10-20 to pay Northwind Hosting.

steps.ask: Read this invoice and tell me the vendor, amount and due date as JSON: {{input}}
Add a reminder on {{read.data.due}} to pay {{read.data.vendor}}.

steps.note: {{read.data.vendor}} sends invoices; the last one was ${{read.data.amount}}.
